items.exampleEn: I heard from Grandma yesterday. She sent me a letter.
items.exampleZh: 我昨天收到奶奶的消息，她寄了一封信給我。

items.exampleEn: Hold on, please. I'll get my mom.
Don't laugh at others. It's not nice.
items.exampleZh: 不要嘲笑別人，這樣不好。

items.exampleEn: The house is empty. Nobody has moved in yet.
items.exampleZh: 這間房子是空的，還沒有人搬進來。

items.exampleEn: I pass by a flower shop every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我每天早上都會經過一家花店。

items.exampleEn: Who will pay for dinner tonight?
Turn around and look at the camera.

items.sentenceEn: We sat by the window and watched people pass by.
items.sentenceZh: 我們坐在窗邊，看著人們經過。

items.audioEn: We haven't heard from Tom since he moved to Japan.
items.audioZh: 自從 Tom 搬去日本以後，我們就沒有他的消息了。
items.questionZh: 說話的人說了 Tom 的什麼事？
options: They have had no news of him
He lives right next door to them

items.sentenceEn: Turn the car around. We went the wrong way.
items.sentenceZh: 把車子掉頭，我們走錯路了。

items.sentenceEn: Hold on to my hand when we cross the street.
items.sentenceZh: 過馬路的時候，抓緊我的手。

items.stemEn: I heard someone call my name from behind, so I ____.
items.stemZh: 我聽到有人在後面叫我的名字，所以我轉過身去。

items.stemEn: I ____ the new bike with my own money.
items.stemZh: 我用自己的錢買了這台新腳踏車。

items.passageEn: Last month, a new family moved in next door. Their son, Ben, is seven. One day I passed by their house and saw Ben crying. Some older boys had laughed at his strange hat. I told him, "Hold on, I'll be right back," and I came back with my old comic books. Now Ben comes over to play every weekend. Yesterday his mother said, "We've heard from Ben's teacher. He is much happier at school now."
items.passageZh: 上個月，有一家人搬進隔壁。他們的兒子 Ben 七歲。有一天我經過他們家，看到 Ben 在哭。有幾個比較大的男生嘲笑他的怪帽子。我跟他說：「等一下，我馬上回來。」然後我帶著我的舊漫畫書回來了。現在 Ben 每個週末都來我家玩。昨天他媽媽說：「我們收到 Ben 老師的消息了，他現在在學校開心多了。」

questions.questionZh: 昨天 Ben 的媽媽說了什麼？

items.promptZh: 上星期六我姊姊幫我付了電影票的錢。
referenceEn: My sister paid for my movie ticket last Saturday.
Last Saturday my sister paid for my movie ticket.
Last Saturday my older sister paid for my movie ticket.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 paid for my movie ticket 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 bought my ticket for me、bought me a ticket 等）也算對
上星期六的事用過去式（例如 paid 等）
「姊姊」可寫，例如 sister、older sister、big sister 等

items.promptZh: 今天上課時，全班都因為老師的笑話笑了。
referenceEn: The whole class laughed at the teacher's joke in class today.
In class today, the whole class laughed at the teacher's joke.
Everyone in class laughed at the teacher's joke today.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 laughed at the teacher's joke 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 laughed because of the joke 等）也算對
今天上課時已經發生的事用過去式（例如 laughed 等）
「全班」可寫，例如 the whole class、everyone in class、all the students 等
